Native source extraction: fishing depletion announcements

Images read from data/runtime/native-pe-images.json:
  reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
  classic   PE:6a70b91c:0270a000

The .c files are actual Ghidra 12.1.4 decompiler output from those PE images.
The .asm files are native objdump output with original bytes' literal operands.
ghidra-functions.tsv records complete function boundaries used by Ghidra.
No game process, desktop, loaded module, or reload state was inspected.

Root producer:
  reference RVA 0x13435b0..0x1344898
  classic   RVA 0x133e520..0x133f808
The producer computes fishing skill/random success, resolves the job's fishing
coordinate, selects matching fish populations and filters their creature/caste
availability. If candidates remain, it consumes population and creates the fish
item. This successful path does not emit an announcement. No stock-recovery
announcement exists in this owner.

When the candidate list is empty, the location is recorded as exhausted. The
announcement gate is flags & 0x70 for gamemode == 0, flags & 8 otherwise. Each
text branch submits announcement type 0x110, packed with color 0x6 as 0x60110,
via RVA 0xe3c20 (reference) / 0xe3bb0 (classic). The body is always followed by
a period. Three text branches exist:

1. Local feature index != -1
   reference assembly 0x1343bc3..0x1343dac
   classic assembly   0x133eb33..0x133ed1c
   Validate feature-map coordinates and local-feature vector index, then call
   feature_init::getName at vtable byte slot 0x70. There is no feature_type or
   fishing_feature test at this call. The text is exactly:
     "There is nothing to catch in " + feature_name + "."

   The upstream selector is reference 0x14a27e0..0x14a296e and classic
   0x149d750..0x149d8de. These are each five contiguous unwind ranges, not a
   short 0x59-byte function. It bounds-checks map coordinates and reads tile
   designation bits 28/29 to choose block local/global feature IDs. It does not
   filter the feature_init subclass. The producer gives local features priority.

   All feature_init RTTI classes and slot implementations are retained in
   native-feature-owners.tsv. There are eleven class types, ten distinct slot
   implementations (cave and subterranean_from_layer share the same text):
     feature_initst                         -> empty (ret)
     feature_init_outdoor_riverst            -> "the river"
     feature_init_cavest                     -> "the cave"
     feature_init_subterranean_from_layerst  -> "the cave"
     feature_init_pitst                      -> "the pit"
     feature_init_magma_poolst               -> "the magma pool"
     feature_init_volcanost                  -> "the volcano"
     feature_init_deep_surface_portalst      -> "the underworld portal"
     feature_init_magma_core_from_layerst    -> "the subterranean water"
     feature_init_underworld_from_layerst    -> "the underworld"
     feature_init_deep_special_tubest        -> material_name + " deposit"

   "the subterranean water" is the actual magma_core slot literal in both
   images. It must not be replaced from an inferred class-name meaning.
   This dispatch is not a named river/site/language-name supplier. No arbitrary
   named-waterbody branch exists here. The base slot, if selected, emits exactly
   "There is nothing to catch in ."; no placeholder or double space is inserted.

2. No local feature; global feature index != -1
   reference assembly 0x1343e45..0x1344114
   classic assembly   0x133edd5..0x133f084
   "There is nothing to catch in the " + direction + " " + layer + "."
   direction is computed by dividing x/y map extent into thirds. Strict low
   test is coordinate < extent/3; strict high is coordinate > 2*extent/3.
   The middle band includes the two boundary coordinates. The nine outcomes:
     northwestern, southwestern, northeastern, southeastern,
     western, northern, eastern, southern, central.
   layer.type 0 -> "cavern"; 1 -> "magma sea"; 2 -> "eerie cavern".
   The default branch appends no layer name, preserving the preceding space.
   Thus the nine "... the northern ."-style forms are retained as native
   default outputs; this does not assert they occur in ordinary world data.

3. No local or global feature
   reference assembly 0x134415c..0x134446f
   classic assembly   0x133f0cc..0x133f3df
   Same prefix and nine direction branches, then the surface biome selector:
     biome 0x1b, 0x1c, 0x1d -> "ocean"
     biome 0x24..0x29       -> "lake"
     all other values      -> "swamps"
   A period follows. There is no empty surface terrain branch.

Material field used only by the deep-special-tube slot:
  reference getName 0xa4a940 -> material supplier 0x14d1920..0x14d1d79
  classic   getName 0xa48170 -> material supplier 0x14cc890..0x14ccce9
  Inputs: feature+0x40 int16 material type; feature+0x44 int32 material index;
          category flags = 0; adjective = false; state = 0 (solid).
  The optional generic-category literals plant/yarn/wood/wooden/cloth/silk/bone/
  leather/shell/soap/ivory/tooth/horn/pearl are in the shared material supplier,
  but their category-mask branches are not reachable with this call's flags=0.
  Reachable composition, in order:
    a. For historical-figure material types 0xdb..0x1a2, a matching figure with
       its has-name flag can supply a language name; append that name and "'s ".
       Even if the name resolution is empty, the suffix "'s " is appended.
    b. Resolve the material using (type,index).
       Failure appends "unknown material" (after any owner prefix).
       Success optionally appends NAME_PREFIX (+0x520) plus one space, then
       STATE_NAME[solid] (+0xb8) using its actual string length.
    c. getName appends " deposit" unconditionally.
  There is no nonempty STATE_NAME guard. The empty raw-data paths are therefore:
    no owner/prefix/name -> feature " deposit";
    prefix only         -> feature "<prefix>  deposit";
    owner only          -> feature "<owner>'s  deposit";
    empty owner only    -> feature "'s  deposit".
  Both prefix and owner may coexist; field-supplied whitespace is not normalized
  by the native producer. The completely empty material yields exactly
  "There is nothing to catch in  deposit." (two spaces after "in").
  These are producer-permitted field values, not claims that shipped RAW files
  contain empty solid names or that every feature type naturally has fish.

The finite-productions.tsv source inventory contains the 54 ordinary directional
forms, nine empty-layer default forms, eight unique feature labels, empty feature,
unknown-material deposit and empty-material deposit. Dynamic material forms are
recorded separately in field-productions.tsv; material RAW names and personal
names are open fields and must retain their established material/name handling.

Literal inventory note: movdqa "!" at producer 0x1343e8f/0x13441e6 is the numeric
std::string size/capacity vector (length 0x21), not an exclamation-mark suffix.
Suffixes such as " to catch in " are overlapping load operands of the same
prefix, not separate announcements. The whole C construction and explicit
lengths determine the produced text.
